handoff.outcome: Audited duration/duration.js against the spec (parse h/m/s duration strings, any order, each unit at most once, throws on anything else). Implementation is correct: verified via existing test suite (all 3 pass) plus manual edge-case checks (whitespace, decimals, negatives, repeated units, missing digits, wrong-case units, non-string input, empty string) — all behaved as expected. No bugs found.
handoff.deliverables: No code changes; this was a read-only audit. Findings documented in this handoff.
handoff.resume_context: No follow-up needed. If re-auditing, note duration.js regex is /^(\d+)([hms])/ applied iteratively via re.exec + slice against the remaining string, with a Set tracking seen units.
